nodes.description: ISalt state variable storing the external Salt contract address
Constructor that initializes the salt state variable with the provided address
Public view function returning the token URI based on the Salt contract start date and elapsed days
Block timestamp used in the time-dependent token URI calculation
Subtraction of salt.startDate() from block.timestamp, a timestamp-dependent arithmetic operation
Addition of tokenId and daysPassed, an arithmetic operation
Token ID parameter of the tokenURI function
Address parameter of the constructor used to set the salt state variable
Local variable storing the number of days passed in the 180-day cycle
External view function of ISalt called to retrieve the Salt contract start date
External view function of ISalt called to retrieve the raw token URI

edges.reason: Constructor parameter a is assigned to the salt state variable
Constructor executes the assignment to the salt state variable
tokenURI reads the salt state variable
salt.startDate() result is used in the timestamp subtraction
salt instance is used to call startDate
salt instance is used to call rawURI
block.timestamp is used in a timestamp-dependent subtraction, mapping to access_control timestamp dependency
tokenURI if branch computes the timestamp subtraction
tokenURI else branch computes the token ID addition
daysPassed is computed from timestamp subtraction and modulo/division, an arithmetic relation
tokenId parameter is added to daysPassed in an arithmetic operation
tokenId parameter is passed directly to salt.rawURI in the first branch
daysPassed local variable is added to tokenId in an arithmetic operation
computed token ID from tokenId + daysPassed is passed to salt.rawURI in the else branch
External call to salt.startDate() may allow reentrancy into tokenURI
External call to salt.rawURI() may allow reentrancy into tokenURI
